caption: The drawing depicts fifteen square swatches of fabric arranged in three horizontal rows and five vertical columns on a plain, off-white background. Each swatch shows a different color and pattern. The top row includes, from left to right: a pink or light red diagonal weave; a green and red check pattern with white; a solid brownish-pink swatch; a blue and gray herringbone pattern; and a plain yellow swatch. The second row has a red and green tartan plaid; a black and white checkered pattern; a solid light blue swatch; a bright solid orange swatch; and a swatch with a wavy gray and white pattern. In the third row, from left to right: a yellow and blue check pattern; a maroon or burgundy solid swatch; a vertical striped swatch in red, peach, and green; a blue and white plaid; and a red and black grid pattern. All swatches have slightly frayed edges, and each square is illustrated with careful detail to depict the weave and texture of the cloth.
title: Factory Cloth Samples
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
